plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: [ -z "$COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" ] || [ "${nextRelease.version}" = "$COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" ] || { echo "semantic-release decided ${nextRelease.version}, but the package job built $COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" >&2; exit 1; }

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tashtit/cockpit/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

or `brew install --cask tashtit/tap/cockpit`. Either checks the download against the SHA-256 digest GitHub lists for it and opens without a trip to Privacy & Security. After that, Cockpit updates itself.

Prefer the `.dmg`? Pick yours below — `arm64` for Apple silicon, `x64` for Intel. It isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS blocks its first launch once: click **Done**, then **Open Anyway** in System Settings › Privacy & Security (or `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cockpit.app`).

[Install guide](https://tashtit.github.io/cockpit/guide/getting-started) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/tashtit/cockpit/issues/new?template=bug.yml) · Verify a download: `gh attestation verify <file> --owner tashtit`
